title: Chola art: more temples, styles, links

boxes.title: Styles: added detail
items: Nagara: on a stone platform; usually **no** boundary walls or gateways; from **5th c.**; also Lakshmana, **Kedarnath**
⚠ some notes: Brihadeeswara a Nagara-Dravida fusion; follow **Dravida**
Chola style continued under **Kalyani Chalukyas** and **Hoysalas**

boxes.title: Literature: added
items: Kamban: Tamil **adaptation**, not a mere translation of Valmiki
Periya Puranam = **Tiruttondarpuranam**; added as Tirumurai's **12th** book
**Moovar Ula**: Kulottunga I, Vikrama Chola, Kulottunga II
Tirumurai = "Fifth Veda" / "Tamil Veda"; ⚠ ==Saiva only==, no Alvar hymns

boxes.title: Trade & current
items: Embassies to China: **1015**, **1033**, **1077**; Srivijaya king **Sri Mara Vijayotunga Varman**
**Kaveripattinam**: traded with Sri Lanka, SE Asia, **Rome**
Poompuhar finds: wharves, **4th-century BCE** pottery, a lighthouse
